answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities with bonded escrow and fraud bounties. Each identity must lock a refundable bond before trading; proven fraud slashes the bond and pays the whistleblower, so a zenith of trust is earned only by identities that survive scrutiny. Honest agents climb a terrace of graduated tiers as their bonds age without incident, while an echo of identical behavior across accounts triggers review. An attacker must fund a separate bond per fake identity — and forfeits every bond the moment one fraud is proven — making mass fakery capital-intensive instead of free.
